analyst_view.overall: Rennes (5th) have picked up only six points from their last five league games and lost 5-2 at Nice before a 0-0 Europa League draw with Olympiacos on Wednesday. Lille are 2nd behind PSG, have kept five league clean sheets, and drew 0-0 at Bodø/Glimt in the Champions League on Tuesday. Franck Haise has confirmed top scorer Esteban Lepaul is out with an ankle sprain, while Frankowski should return and Brice Samba should start in goal despite a hip problem.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Rennes are without Esteban Lepaul for a fifth straight game. Lille have injury problems up front too, with Ayase Ueda doubtful and Hamza Igamane out. Davide Ancelotti's Lille have five clean sheets in nine league games and both teams drew 0-0 in Europe this week.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. The news doesn't point clearly either way. Rennes at home should have spells of pressure, but Lille are comfortable keeping things tight.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards with Clément Turpin in charge. Tanguy Nianzou is back for Lille after a red-card suspension, but nothing else in the news suggests a more or less heated game than the model expects.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.8 shots. Both teams are missing their main forwards (Lepaul for Rennes; Ueda doubtful and Igamane out for Lille) and both played European games in midweek. Lille's tight defensive setup should keep the total a little down.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Without Lepaul, Rennes rely on Boulaye Dia for goals, and Lille's back line has been the meanest outside PSG. We expect slightly fewer clear efforts than the model.
